readManifest.scanEscalationReason: High-risk lifecycle/gate change (story adds/extends 3 gates touching canStartDevGuard, canSkipPlanGuard, canReenterDevGuard, canFinishGuard) plus candidate ambiguity: candidate-spec-set.json's own top-8 ranked routing (score 40-64, generic term overlap on 'advisory'/'capture'/'handlers'/'import'/'registration'/'guard') did not surface either dev-memory.md or playbook-runtime-memory-consumption-execution-plan.md in its top ranks despite both being directly on-topic. Beyond the two full reads, ran targeted rg sweeps across the full decisions/ corpus for exact symbol/command names (dev_memory_preflight_ack, dev_memory_finish_decision, finding_resolve, canFinishGuard, canStartDevGuard, canSkipPlanGuard, canReenterDevGuard, dev-memory/dev_memory, INIT_CHECK gate pattern, scope_boundary_set/execution_boundary_set) and spot-read matched sections of story-lifecycle.md, lifecycle-artifact-scope.md, red-evidence-legacy-v1-record-validation-audit.md, lattice-experience-layer-execution-plan.md, session-ownership-and-write-leases.md, and proof-or-stop-thin-entrypoint-contract-migration-execution-plan.md (the top-ranked candidate) to rule out missed direct commitments. All matched hits were either the guard-reacher-chain architecture facts already reflected in understanding.json, a different/future Experience Layer system (B-1480, explicitly a not-yet-implemented plan) whose 'never automatically finding_resolve / change a gate' principle governs a separate advisory-hint system rather than this story's dev-memory output-splice, or generic keyword overlap unrelated to dev-memory gating. No further full-content reads beyond the two candidates were warranted.

openQuestions.q: docs/requirements/decisions/dev-memory.md's own Non-Goals list states 'Dev-memory entries are NOT surfaced in lattice validate output or gate checks' -- a separate, differently-worded commitment from the already-reconciled playbook-runtime-memory-consumption-execution-plan.md M8/Non-Goal text (OQ-1/OQ-2, resolved in the prior PLAN round). plan.md's Reconciliation section and CHK-005 only cite and update playbook-runtime-memory-consumption-execution-plan.md; dev-memory.md itself is not read, cited, or scheduled for a corresponding update anywhere in plan.md, decision.json, or the checklist. Does this story's CHK-001/CHK-003 gate-existence-of-a-record design also require reconciling/updating dev-memory.md's own Non-Goal wording (even if, per the same record-of-reflection-vs-content-as-evidence reasoning already used for OQ-1, the gates do not actually surface dev-memory ENTRIES in validate/gate output, only the separate ack/finish-decision sidecar artifacts), or is dev-memory.md intentionally left as-is because its Non-Goal is scoped to entry CONTENT, not to sidecar attestation records?
openQuestions.evidence: dev-memory.md Non-Goals: 'Dev-memory entries are NOT surfaced in `lattice validate` output or gate checks.' plan.md Reconciliation section and CHK-005's title/context reference only 'the pre-existing playbook-runtime-memory-consumption-execution-plan.md spec doc'; dev-memory.md is absent from plan.md's Reconciliation section, decision.json, and all five checklist item titles.
openQuestions.resolution: dev-memory.md's Non-Goal (line 163, 'entries are NOT surfaced in lattice validate output or gate checks') is about DevMemoryEntry JSONL row CONTENT, whose gateEvidence:false/authority:non_authoritative fields exist specifically so no consumer treats lesson text as gate evidence (doc's own FAQ, lines 152-154). CHK-001's preflight-ack and CHK-003's finish-decision are a separate artifact type -- no gateEvidence/authority fields, because they never claimed non-authoritative status over content; they record only that a reflection ritual occurred, never the lesson text. Same record-of-reflection-vs-entry-content distinction already applied to OQ-1/OQ-2. Added CHK-006 to update dev-memory.md's Non-Goals wording with a 'delivered differently' style clarification, preserving the original line as still-true for entry content.
